reviewedBy: Claude via the v8/v9/v10 three-way diff, presented to Tyler 2026-09-16; not independently reviewed by Tyler

base.rationale: I want a convenient, trustworthy way to cover my daily greens and micronutrients that I'll actually drink every day without wasting money.

scenarios.label: Subscribe-and-save setup
scenarios.description: Setting up an auto-ship plan on a brand site for convenience and a lower per-serving cost.

scenarios.label: Amazon Prime purchase
scenarios.description: Choosing a well-reviewed greens powder on Amazon with fast delivery, sometimes via Subscribe & Save.

scenarios.label: Natural grocery shelf pick
scenarios.description: Comparing labels and prices in-store at a health grocer to bring home a tub today.

scenarios.label: Club-store bulk restock
scenarios.description: Buying a larger format at a warehouse club for better value per serving and steady availability.

cellTexts: [problem_recognition|Subscribe-and-save setup|generic] I keep missing veggies on crazy workdays and my stomach feels off. Is there a simple daily thing I can put on auto-delivery so I stop falling off the wagon?
[problem_recognition|Amazon Prime purchase|generic] Feeling low energy and my diet's light on greens lately. Anything I can grab on Amazon Prime today to help cover the gaps?

[problem_recognition|Natural grocery shelf pick|generic] i'm in the natural grocery staring at a wall of health stuff. i just want an easy way to get more nutrients each day without cooking. what am i even looking for?

[problem_recognition|Club-store bulk restock|generic] Doing a warehouse run to restock. I want something I can take daily to cover the basics, comes in a big size so I don't run out, minimal prep. What fits that?
[category_education|-|generic] What do daily greens powders actually do? Are they just veggies in another form, or more like a multivitamin? who really benefits from them?
[discovery|Subscribe-and-save setup|generic] Best daily greens powder for a morning routine I can subscribe to monthly? mild taste, easy on the stomach, not super sweet.
[discovery|Amazon Prime purchase|generic] What are the best daily greens powders I can get with Prime shipping? decent flavor, low sugar, ideally some quality testing behind it.
[discovery|Natural grocery shelf pick|generic] In a natural foods store right now. Best daily greens powder to grab off the shelf, and what should I check on the label so I don't pick junk?
[discovery|Club-store bulk restock|generic] Looking for the best daily greens powder in a big tub for a club-store run. Good value per serving, not loaded with sweeteners, mixes fast.
[shortlist|Subscribe-and-save setup|generic] Can you narrow it to 3 or 4 daily greens powders that work well for a monthly subscription? gentle on digestion, tastes fine with water.
[shortlist|Amazon Prime purchase|generic] Shortlist me 3 good daily greens powders that are Prime-eligible with fast shipping and strong reviews.
[shortlist|Natural grocery shelf pick|generic] i'm in the natural grocery aisle. give me 3 daily greens powders I'm likely to see here that are actually worth buying.
[shortlist|Club-store bulk restock|generic] I buy in bulk at the warehouse store. Which 2 or 3 daily greens powders come in large containers and don't taste like lawn clippings?

[criteria|Subscribe-and-save setup|generic] setting up subscribe & save for a daily greens. what actually matters so I don't get stuck with the wrong one long term? ingredients, testing, per-serving cost on autoship, shelf life?

[criteria|Amazon Prime purchase|generic] about to grab a greens powder on Prime. what should I check besides star ratings? label must-haves, third-party testing, sweeteners, any red flags in the listing?
[criteria|Natural grocery shelf pick|generic] in the natural foods aisle staring at a wall of green tubs. how do I pick fast? what on the panel tells me it's legit and not just fairy-dusted greens?

[criteria|Club-store bulk restock|generic] doing a bulk restock at a warehouse club. before I commit to a giant tub of greens, what should I look for so it won't clump, go stale, or taste like lawn clippings by week 3?

[use_case|Subscribe-and-save setup|generic] weekday routine: one scoop first thing, skip weekends, travel twice a month. help me set a subscribe-and-save cadence and portion plan so I don't run out or pile up, and how to handle travel packets vs the tub.

[use_case|Amazon Prime purchase|generic] need a greens powder I can get on Prime today that mixes smooth in a shaker, not too sweet, mostly for gut support and steady energy. what should I search for and which size is best for a 2-week tryout?

[use_case|Natural grocery shelf pick|generic] I'm in the store now, no time to research. want a greens I can drink after workouts that's easy on my stomach. what 60-second checks on the label should I do to decide?

[use_case|Club-store bulk restock|generic] warehouse club run. I use about 5 servings a week. which size makes sense, how do I store a big tub to keep it fresh, and does buying bulk actually beat regular-size cost per serving?

[social_validation|-|generic] which daily greens powders are people actually sticking with and rating well right now? any subreddits or communities where folks share honest before/after or mixability/taste notes?

[comparison|Subscribe-and-save setup|Amazing Grass] setting up subscribe & save: AG1 vs Amazing Grass - how do they compare on autoship price per serving, ingredient quality/variety, third-party testing, taste, and how easy it is to pause or cancel? I drink it first thing mornings.

[comparison|Amazon Prime purchase|Garden of Life] buying on Prime tonight: AG1 or Garden of Life greens - which is the smarter pick there? price per serving on current listings, delivery speed, authenticity (seller to choose), and anything the reviews hint at for taste/gi issues.

[comparison|Natural grocery shelf pick|Organifi] I'm looking at AG1 and Organifi at my natural market. quick take for daily use: which would you grab if you care about digestibility, minimal sweeteners, and how much nutrition you get per scoop?

[comparison|Club-store bulk restock|Vega] warehouse club has a big tub of Vega greens, but I've been using AG1 at home. for a bulk restock, is it worth switching? compare cost per serving, ingredient profile, taste/mixability, and how each holds up once opened.

[objections|Subscribe-and-save setup|generic] Before I lock in a subscribe-and-save, be straight with me: does AG1 actually move the needle on energy/gut health or am I just drinking pricey greens with no real effect?

[objections|Amazon Prime purchase|generic] About to grab AG1 on Prime - does it actually do anything you can feel, or is this one of those "nice idea, zero results" powders? How fast would I notice a difference if it works?
[objections|Natural grocery shelf pick|generic] I'm in the aisle looking at AG1 - real talk, does this perform any better than eating well + a basic multi, or is the hype bigger than the results?

[objections|Club-store bulk restock|generic] Thinking of a bulk restock of AG1 at the club store - does this stuff actually deliver measurable benefits over time, or am I just locking into an expensive routine with no real performance gains?

[pricing|Subscribe-and-save setup|generic] Setting up subscribe-and-save for AG1 - what's the honest value per serving vs buying one-time, and are the bundle/travel pack tiers actually cheaper long run or just marketing?
[pricing|Amazon Prime purchase|generic] If I buy AG1 on Amazon with Prime, am I overpaying vs their site's subscribe deal? What's the real cost-per-serving after shipping/discounts either way?

[pricing|Natural grocery shelf pick|generic] I'm staring at a wall of greens powders - what's a fair price per serving that's actually worth it, and at what point am I better off just eating produce or making a DIY smoothie?

[pricing|Club-store bulk restock|generic] Buying a big tub at the club store - how do I figure if the bulk greens powder is truly cheaper per serving after freshness/expiration waste, or should I stick to smaller bags?

[churn_triggers|-|generic] I've been on AG1 daily for about a year and I'm not sure it's doing much anymore - energy feels the same and it's not cheap. How do I tell if I should stick with it or switch to something else?
[alternatives|-|defensive] If I don't want to keep paying for AG1, what daily greens are solid substitutes? easy to mix, not crazy sweet, good for busy mornings.
[alternatives|-|Amazing Grass] What can I use instead of Amazing Grass greens? similar benefits, cleaner taste if possible, and quick to mix between meetings.
[alternatives|-|Garden of Life] garden of life greens keep messing with my stomach. any gentler alternatives that still cover the basics?
[alternatives|-|Organifi] Looking for alternatives to Organifi Green Juice I can afford monthly. What else hits the essentials without the premium price?
[alternatives|-|Vega] Not loving the Vega greens texture. What are better-mixing options people actually like for a shaker at work?
[renewal|-|generic] My AG1 subscription is up. worth keeping or should I switch to something cheaper? I like the convenience but the price stings a bit.
[problem_resolution|-|generic] AG1 keeps clumping in my shaker and tastes chalky lately. any fix? bag's been open about 6 weeks and I store it in the pantry.
[expansion|-|generic] I've been using AG1 for 6 months and feel good. other smart ways to work it into my day - travel packs, afternoon slump, post-workout - without overdoing it?

[ecosystem|-|generic] What pairs well with AG1 to make it easier on the palate and gut? water vs coconut water, ice, lemon? and anything I shouldn't take with it at the same time (iron, coffee, probiotics)?
[advocacy|-|generic] Friend says AG1 is just pricey spinach water. how do I explain what it actually covers and when it's worth it without sounding salesy?
